description: Read a sequence's recurring schedule: the audience it re-enrolls, how often (daily, weekly on chosen weekdays, or monthly on chosen days including the last day), the time and IANA timezone, a readable description, the next run times (upcomingRuns), and the last run or skipped occurrence. recurringEnrollment is null when the sequence has no schedule.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_sequence_recurring_enrollment

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_sequence_recurring_enrollment` MCP tool.

description.description: Readable summary such as "Monthly on the 1st and the last day at 10:00 (Europe/London)", or null.

enrollmentMode.description: Who enters at each run: unlimited (everyone who matches) or one_time (only people who never entered). The sequence's enrollment mode.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

recurringEnrollment.description: The schedule: enabled, audience, schedule (frequency, weekdays, monthDays with "last" for the last day, time, timezone), enabledAt, nextRunAt, lastRunAt, lastRunId, lastSkippedAt, lastSkipReason (not_accepting or missed) and endsAt (no runs after it; nextRunAt is null once nothing is left). Null when the sequence has no schedule.

upcomingRuns.description: Next run times as ISO 8601 instants; empty while switched off.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
